method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (a condition from before 1 July 2004 answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Military Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2004, Compilation No. 77, compilation date 29 September 2026 (register id C2026C00443, retrieved 2026-10-13), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A01285.txt. No instrument brought in; the formulas of ss 78(5), 129-131 are missing from the deposit and are not supplied; the Guide's impairment points and the indexed s 74 maximum are inputs. Added 2026-10-24: the Guide to Determining Impairment and Compensation 2026 (F2026L00595), deposited at subjects/au/guide-to-determining-impairment-and-compensation-2026 with a formulas sidecar, read by mrca-guide.l4 (Chapter 23, Tables 23.1 and 23.2).

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run mrca-member.l4 ; l4 run mrca-cases-member.l4 ; l4 run mrca-guide.l4 ; l4 run mrca-cases-guide.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the member or former member: s 27 (service injury and disease), s 335 (standard of proof by kind of service, s 6), ss 23(1), 32(1)-(2), 33(1), 34(1), 35, 36 (acceptance of liability and exclusions), s 319(2), (2A) (claims), ss 68(1), (3), 69, 74(1), 77(1), 78(1)-(4), 79(1)-(2) (permanent impairment: entitlement, threshold, start date, lump sum options, deadlines), ss 118, 120-122, 129(2), 131(2) (former members' incapacity: which rate and the adjustment percentage), ss 345(1), 346(5), 352A, 352B(1), 354(1) (Board and Tribunal). Out: conditions before 1 July 2004 (not covered), s 24 and Chapter 5, s 27A and the SoPs, ss 29, 30, 70-72, 75 beyond its existence, 80-83A, Chapter 3, Part 3 and Divisions 3-7 of Part 4 of Chapter 4, s 130, Part 6, Chapter 6, ss 320-343 beyond 319 and 335, 347-350, 352C onwards. Added 2026-10-24 (mrca-guide.l4): the Guide's Chapter 23 compensation factors and mixed-service formula, the weekly amount and the s 78 shares on it; impairment and lifestyle ratings are inputs.
seat: the current or former member of the Australian Defence Force with a condition from service on or after 1 July 2004
